title: Gold Bar Salts Cherry Fizz Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Cherry Fizz by Gold Bar captures the punchy sweetness of ripe Cherry with a sparkling twist that adds depth and vibrancy to every puff. The cherry note is juicy and full-bodied, while a fizzy, slightly tart undercurrent creates a light confectionery-style finish without overwhelming the palate. Formulated with nicotine salts for a smooth inhale and rapid absorption, this 10ml e-liquid features a 50/50 VG/PG ratio—perfect for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. It’s well-suited to pod systems, vape pens and compact starter kits. Whether you're after a sweet-fruit profile with a fizzy edge or simply enjoy Cherry flavours with a playful twist, this Nic Salt delivers a layered, flavourful vape. Explore the full range of Gold Bar Nic Salt e-liquids at Vapestore.
